note: Maps findMotifs() tags in blind-chess.html to Education System concept ids.
findMotifs() stays the authority on WHETHER a motif is present in a position.
The concept record supplies what it means, where it came from, its exceptions,
and how to word it for a given reader. Neither side has to rename anything.
A tag with concept null has no researched record yet and is a tracked gap.
Themes are classified below: some name chess ideas, some are properties of the PUZZLE and must never become chess concepts.
detector: findMotifs(before, move, after, attackerColor) in blind-chess.html

mate.note: the rule, not a pattern; the pattern records are under named-mating-patterns

fork.note: detector requires target outranked or undefended — matches this record's indicators_for

pin.note: detector reports only pins the move CREATED

skewer.note: same slider-line pass as pin, split by value ordering

backRank.note: detector tag covers the weakness as well as the mate; the record distinguishes them

theme_tags_without_concepts.note: Puzzle-level themes from tools/puzzle_rules.js themesOf(). Classified by whether they name a chess idea at all. Verified by reading the assignment code, not guessed from the tag name.

kingAttack.caveat: The tag is a crude proxy. The CONCEPT is real and worth researching; the detector's rule is not the concept's definition.

sacrifice.assigned_by: material given up that SEE says was takeable

pawnBreakthrough.assigned_by: pawn advance creating a decisive passer

removalOfDefender.caveat: ALREADY HAS A RECORD under the id removing-the-defender. Name mismatch only.

perpetual.assigned_by: checks >= 2 and final eval within 60cp of level

mateThreat.assigned_by: read off the final evaluation: mate follows but is not delivered

exchangeSacrifice.assigned_by: rook given for a minor piece

positionalTactic.assigned_by: quiet first move, not a capture, not a check
positionalTactic.caveat: NOT a recognised chess term. It is the generator's label for 'a quiet move with no motif tag'. Do NOT create a concept called 'positional tactic' — research what such moves actually are (prophylaxis, restriction, improving the worst piece) and map to those.

promotion.assigned_by: a promotion occurs in the line

zwischenzug.assigned_by: an in-between move detected in the solution line

puzzle_metadata_not_chess_concepts.note: These describe the PUZZLE, not the chess. They must never receive concept records — doing so would be inventing chess terminology to fit a pipeline tag, which is the failure mode the brief forbids.
puzzle_metadata_not_chess_concepts.longGame: rec.moves.length >= 3 and not a mate. A statement about the line's length.
puzzle_metadata_not_chess_concepts.defensiveResource: the puzzle's KIND — tagged on all 509 rescues, i.e. puzzles where the solver is saving rather than punishing.

deliberately_unclaimed.note: The puzzle generator refuses these five by design: 'every cheap test for them fires where it is not true'. This knowledge base independently classified the same five detectability:heuristic from the sources. Do not add detectors for them without criteria strong enough to survive false-positive testing.
